title: Build the questions. Inspect the decision.
intro: Edit two texts and the criteria used to assess them. First inspect what will be sent; then run an independent assessment of each article.
key_ready: API key ready in the local runtime
key_missing: No runtime API key — editing and validation remain available
article_note: Paste complete texts. The model receives article A or B, never their filenames, reference answers or the other article. Sample buttons replace the two text fields; interface language buttons do not translate them.
policy_note: Expand a criterion to edit the exact question and all three answer definitions. Questions may be written in your chosen language; they are sent as entered.
preset_note: Select a language and load a preset to replace the current questions and answer definitions. Switching interface language alone does not translate your draft. The visit preset follows the original experiment; rhetoric is an uncalibrated starting point for other topics.
version: Policy version — change when editing the method
question: Exact assessment instructions
probability: Minimum probability for present / absent (0.5 < P ≤ 1)
threshold_note: The model answers first. These thresholds are applied by the application afterwards. Lowering them does not change what the question means and does not establish correctness.
routing: 3. What should the application do with the answers?
routing_note: Choose feature comparison only, or select the question that detects authorial persuasion: present → commentary, absent → mainly reporting. Any uncertain feature or API error → review.
routing_warning: If you change that question’s meaning, update this mapping too. The library’s aggregate pass/fail is not an overall grade of an article.
paid_note: Live assessment sends both texts and these questions to OpenRouter / Jev, in up to two billable requests. It stops after a provider error. Token counts and costs appear in the result.
preview: Validate and inspect — no API call
history_note: Each assessment keeps its texts, exact questions, thresholds, model identity and costs. Editing a completed run creates a new submission; old results are not overwritten.
validated: Valid configuration — no API request made
questions: Questions including the common framework instruction
edit_run: Edit these texts and criteria for a new assessment
invalid: Check unique criterion IDs, all question/answer definitions, valid thresholds, both articles and the routing selection. No automatic retry was made.
footer: Local teaching workbench · policy execution uses the same Gate API as an application · no general bias or truth score.
preset_language: Question language for the preset to load
